summary: Frontend-only verification completed on public preview URL. Mobile homepage news card behavior works (3 on <=767, 6 on >=768, and 3->6->3 on resize without extra feed fetch). EDSAA page metadata/text checks mostly pass, but key navigation/routing/scope regressions remain.

ui_bugs.issue: EDSAA pages include a full register-interest form section, violating the requested minimal EDSAA page scope (no extra forms/sections).
Required EDSAA submenu link is missing in both languages across site pages (0/68 pages contain href='edsaa.html' in NOVA submenu).

integration_issues.issue: Expected /tr/edsaa and /en/edsaa -> 301 to .html is not active on preview; both return 404 (curl) and browser stays on /en/edsaa 404 page.
Legacy tests still encode old 66-page assumptions and stale baseline paths; current run failed 6 tests mainly due count/baseline drift, masking real product regressions.

action_items: Insert exactly one standard EDSAA <a href='edsaa.html'> under .submenu[data-id='nova-konut'] in both TR/EN templates so all 68 pages include it.
Remove register-interest/contact form block from TR/EN EDSAA pages; keep only approved intro + existing EastWest render + small project link.
Fix preview routing so /tr/edsaa and /en/edsaa return single-hop 301 to /tr/edsaa.html and /en/edsaa.html.
Update/replace stale regression tests with 68-page aware assertions and EDSAA-specific contracts to prevent false failures.
critical_code_review_comments: build_edsaa.py add_menu_link() regex targets <div class='submenu' ...>, but real markup uses <ul class='submenu' ...>; this explains missing EDSAA links site-wide.
EDSAA build currently starts from contact pages and retains full register section/footer shell content blocks not permitted by the requested EDSAA scope.
Scrollbar implementation is correct and native: html scrollbar-width: thin and color resolves to rgb(107, 94, 67) with light track; no JS interception detected.
Newsroom homepage cap logic is correctly implemented in js/news.js (matchMedia max-width:767, slice(0,3/6), resize listener with cached feed; no extra network fetch on resize observed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public URL from frontend/.env. Confirmed exact TR/EN titles/meta/intro/canonical/hreflang and X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow are correct on EDSAA pages. JSON-LD uses shared TR @id and only minimal keys. Major remaining failures are functional: missing EDSAA menu link across all pages, extensionless EDSAA routes 404 (no 301), and disallowed extra form section on EDSAA pages. Home news cards pass dynamic count contract (TR+EN mobile=3, tablet=6, TR resize 3->6->3 without new feed request).
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Missing EDSAA menu link: build script regex mismatch (expects div.submenu, actual files use ul.submenu), so insertion never occurs. RCA-2 Extensionless EDSAA 404: preview runtime routing does not currently apply intended redirect rules for /tr/edsaa and /en/edsaa. RCA-3 Extra form section: EDSAA pages are generated from contact shell and retain register-interest block, conflicting with strict content scope requirements.
